hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y (positive static gain).
Step response has short delay/lag of 1-5 s before level visibly rises.
There is negligible dead-zone; even small u > 0.1 produces rise relative to u=0.
At u=0 the level decays on its own toward low values with time constant of order tens of seconds.
Gain is approximately linear across u in [0,1] with no strong saturation below 0.85.
Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.6 target is in mid-range ~0.3-0.7.
Sensor noise is small (+/-0.02) relative to control band width 0.10.

Change is weaker actuator: same u gives smaller rise rate and lower held level with similar short lag.

proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case with no drainage or lag is current y 0.5879 + 0.10*0.0*20.0 = 0.5879, well below soft limit 0.85 with large margin; u=0 can only fall.
proposal.expected_observation: If C3 slower-response is right, y will hold near 0.58-0.60 flat within +/-0.02 for the first ~5-10 s after step to 0, then begin falling at ~0.015-0.03/s to ~0.35-0.50 by 20 s with noise +/-0.015, staying above 0.30. proposal.readiness_justification: Rise delay and intact gain are resolved by E13-E14, and C1/C2/C4 are largely falsified, but fall delay is not yet bounded because E15 held flat for 15 s with no fall, so one long u=0 hold from a settled high level is needed to measure fall onset and drain rate for delay-robust control.
proposal.operator_note: Holding pump off for 20 s from ~0.59 to measure when the delayed drain begins.

submission.machine_card: Reservoir: positive gain (more u = rise). Hold u for y=0.6 is ~0.52-0.55, nominal 0.53; DC gain ~1.13. Speed: net +0.025-0.03/s at u=0.8 mid-level, +0.02/s at u=0.7 near 0.55, +0.01/s at u=0.55 near 0.62; differential Kp ~0.24/s per unit u near target (E11 0.52 slight fall -0.002/s vs E12 0.535 flat +0.0015/s). Lag 0.5-1.5 s near target, 2-4 s from low levels (E5 2-3 s continued fall, E9-E10 3-4 s delayed fall). Dead zone: none found; u>=0.4 already lifts vs u=0. Self-draining: u=0 falls ~0.025/s at y~0.3, 0.39->0.21 in 10 s, tau ~11-16 s (~12 s). Noise +/-0.01-0.015 vs 0.10 band. No strong saturation to 0.65. Danger: 0.85 soft, 0.9 hard forces u=0; max rate 0.08/s.
submission.design_rationale: Feedforward 0.53 (=0.883*target) carries steady-state load so integrator only trims residual; P=0.9 gives ~0.045 correction at band edge (0.05 error) and ~0.27 at 0.3 error for 12-18 s fill without large momentum; I=0.10 with +/-0.25 clamp removes offset from 0.52-0.55 hold uncertainty without windup; 0.8 s exponential filter cuts +/-0.015 noise to ~+/-0.005 while adding <1 s lag vs 1-3 s plant lag and ~12 s drain time constant; conditional freeze on saturation plus output clamp [0,1], 1.0/s slew, and hard safety (yf>0.75 cap 0.25, yf>0.82 force 0) prevent overshoot to 0.85/0.9.
submission.predicted_behavior: From 0.2-0.3 fill at 0.025-0.04/s, reach 0.55 in ~10-15 s, enter band by ~15-20 s, settle by <25 s well inside 30 s window. Overshoot <0.02-0.03, peak <0.65 from normal starts. After settling MAE ~0.008-0.015 (noise-limited), time in band >90-95%. Steady duty ~0.52-0.55. Energy ~0.28 u^2 per step steady, no chatter.
self_test_expectations: control({}, empty) returns finite u in [0,1] with no exception and inits yf, integ
constant y=0.6, target 0.6 converges u to 0.45-0.60 within 20 s and stays in [0,1]
y=0.2 step: u saturates high but <=1.0, rises monotonically without exceeding 0.75 in first 5 s
yf=0.87 forces u==0.0 safety; yf=0.78 caps u<=0.25
noise +/-0.015 on y causes u jitter <0.02 step-to-step after filter
dt variation 0.05-0.2 s keeps u finite and integ bounded within +/-0.25
submission.operator_note: No tuning needed. Starts from any level, fills gently and holds 0.6 in 0.55-0.65 band. Keeps pump near 0.53 steady. If level exceeds 0.75 it brakes automatically; above 0.82 pump goes to 0. Do not add manual bias.

submission.machine_card: Reservoir FOPDT: dc hold u~0.53 at y=0.6 (gain ~1.13 y/u), K~0.05-0.06/s, tau~12-20s. Nominal dead-time 0.5-2s. Changed dead-time ~7-9s (typ 8s), gain/drain/noise ~unchanged. Target 0.6 band 0.55-0.65, hard cutoff 0.9.
submission.design_rationale: Long delay with high Kp+fast integral+slew causes pump to stay at 1.0 while y flat then overshoot to 0.9 and limit-cycle. Lowering bandwidth so Kp*K*L<<1 restores phase margin for L~8s. Derivative on measurement provides braking before delayed peak. Slew limit prevents bang-bang. Heavier filtering cleans derivative from +/-0.015 noise. Predictive cap cuts pump ~7s early only when yf>0.65, so nominal early rise unaffected but delayed momentum is stopped. Slow bias corrects small steady-state offset for both plants. All caps keep u in [0,1] and preserve nominal feedforward 0.883*target.

Delayed L~8s: no limit cycle, rise in ~30-45s, peak <0.82, zero hard violations/overrides, MAE ~0.05-0.09 (vs 0.215), in-band ~0.55-0.75 improving with time, energy lower (no long 1.0 saturations).
